title: THE FORGE: PLAYER 2S ELEMENTAL ROUNDS
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns and add elemental damage. In two player co-op the host runs every enemy, and player 2 only sends what his rounds did. His shot word now names the element of his MK III round, and the host applies it: the burn, the arc, the stun, the chill and the acid, all credited to player 2, so a burn that finishes a pillager is his kill. Acid eats the plate before the host soaks the round, as it does for the host. An element the game does not know is ignored.
now: Player 2 elemental rounds burn, shock, freeze and corrode on the host too.
